_help: Trackpad feel. Speeds multiply finger travel in points; the Mac receives pixels. Rebuild and redeploy the iOS app after editing. `swift test` checks this file.

cursor._help: gain = min(speed + fingerSpeed / 1000 * accelerationPer1000, maxSpeed), fingerSpeed in pt/s.

scroll._help: Same gain formula as cursor. naturalDirection true = content follows your fingers.

momentum._help: Coasting after lift-off, in Mac pixels/s. velocityKeptPerSecond: 0.135 is iOS-like, lower stops sooner. fullCoastTravel: finger travel in points (whole scroll gesture) that earns the full start velocity; shorter swipes get a proportionally weaker coast. maxVelocity is the backstop.

gestures._help: swipeDistance: points three fingers travel before a swipe fires. dragHoldSeconds: still hold before a drag picks up.
